annotations.title: pdfpeek: render Mermaid diagram code to an SVG or PNG image

description: pdfpeek: Render Mermaid diagram code to an SVG or PNG image. Returns Mermaid diagram code drawn as an SVG or PNG file in an offline sandboxed browser: `format` svg | png, `theme` (default, dark, forest, neutral, base), `scale` 1-4 for PNG (default 2, sharp when zoomed). File base64 in `file` (output=url gives a 24 h link). A syntax error is a 422 invalid_diagram with the line number; over 8,000 x 8,000 px a 422, a PNG over 8 MB a 413 (none charged). Mermaid 11.4.1, strict security, no network. Typically 1-3 s. Price: USD 0.003. No free tier.

code.description: Mermaid diagram source (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie, git graph, mindmap, timeline and the other types of mermaid 11.4.1), 1-20,000 characters. Fenced ``` lines are not needed. A syntax error is a 422 with the line number.
